New York,NewYork10017 T-(212)922-9700 F-(212) 922-0881 ZONINGLOTANDDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOTANDDEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (this "Agreement") is made as of this 20" day of May, 2008, between 413 WEST 14TH ASSOCIATES,a New York partnership,having an address at 421 West 14th Street, Suite 421 3R, New York, New York 10014 ("Transferor") and LM LEGACY GROUP LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, having an address at 421 West 14*h Street, Suite 421 3R, New York, New York 10014 (such entity, together with its successors and assigns, collectively, "Transferee"). RECITALS: A. Transferor is the owner of certain parcels of land known as Tax Lots 14, 21, and 51 in Block 712 on the Tax Map of the City of New York,County of New York, more particularly described in Schedule A annexed hereto and made a part hereof, together with the improvements thereon (said land being herein referred to collectively, as “Transferor's Land,”" and said improvements, together with any future replacements thereof being herein referred to collectively as “Transferor's Existing Building,” and Transferor's Land and Transferor's Existing Building being herein referred to as“Transferor's Property"). B. Transferee is the owner of certain land adjacent to Transferor's Land, known as Tax Lot 42 in Block 712 on the Tax Map of the City of NewYork,County of New York,more particularly described inSchedule B annexed hereto and made a part hereof together with the existing improvements thereon (said land being herein referred to as “Transferee's Land" and said improvements being herein referred to as “Transferee's Existing Building"). C.Transferee may renovate Transferee's Existing Building or construct a new building or buildings and improvements upon all or a portion of Transferee's Land or other adjacent land (said new or renovated building or buildings and improvements, together with any further replacements thereof or additions theretowhether made by Transferee or Transferee's successors or assigns, whether upon Transferee's Land or other adjacent land, being herein referred to as “Transferee's Proposed Building” and Transferee's Land and Transferee's Proposed Building being herein referred to as "Transferee's Property"). D. Transferor's Property into a single “zoning lot,” as such term is defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York, effective December 15, 1961 (as amended to date, Zoning Lot"); E.As used herein, the term “Floor Area Development Rights" shall mean certain rights, as determined by the Zoning Resolution, which are appurtenant to a zoning lot, whereby such zoning lot may be developed by erecting thereon one or more structures with Floor Area (as such term is defined in the Zoning Resolution) determined by multiplying the area of the zoning lot by the allowable Floor Area Ratio (as such term is defined in the Zoning Resolution) in that zoning district.
